about.newsletterDescription: Samu taƙaitaccen mako-mako na mafi kyawun taron. Babu spam, kawai abubuwa masu kyau.
about.openingTitle: Yin Kuskure Akan Wanda Ba A Ƙidaya Ba
about.openingParagraph1: Mu ne ɗalibai waɗanda suka ci gaba da rasa.
about.openingParagraph2: Tony ya sami labarin Instagram game da darussan dafa abinci na Italiya na $5. An buga shi kwanaki 3 da suka gabata. Taron ya riga ya ƙare.
about.openingParagraph3: Erica ta ji game da Man Dancing: Hip-Hop Edition daga poster a cikin hanya. Mintuna 30 kafin ya fara. Ta bayyana, kuma an cika.
about.openingParagraph4: Mako mai zuwa, ta gano game da Gasar Ƙwanƙwasa Hannun Injiniya a cikin Discord na bazuwar. Wannan shine lokacin da muka gane: duk mafi kyawun taron suna ɓoye.
about.photo1Caption: Ɗaya daga cikin ɗaruruwan taron da muka gano da makara.
about.phase2Paragraph1: Muna zaune a cikin SLC, muna korafin rasa wani taron kuma (wannan lokacin ya kasance Chipotle kyauta a wurin haɗuwa na Mata a Injiniya), lokacin da Erica ta ce: "Me ya sa ba kawai... wuri ɗaya don duk wannan?"
about.phase2Paragraph3: Tony ya sarrafa backend—goge Instagram na ƙungiyoyi, haɗuwa da abincin WUSA, gina ka'idar tacewa. Erica ta tsara komai: zane-zane, alamomin da aka zana da hannu, pallet na launi.
about.phase2Paragraph4: Sigar farko ta kasance m. Amma ta yi aiki.
about.photo2Caption: Marayen dare a cikin SLC. Tony akan backend, Erica akan zane.
about.phase3Paragraph1: Mun buga hanyar a cikin wasu tattaunawar rukuni. Sa'an nan muka yi poster (abin ban mamaki, mun sani) kuma muka makala shi a cikin SLC. A cikin mako guda, mutane suna aiko mana da hotunan allo.
about.phase3Paragraph2: "Jira, akwai Ƙungiyar Gyara? Zan iya gyara keken na a can?"
about.phase3Paragraph3: Wani ya sami Ƙungiyar Gatka (fasahar yaƙi na Sikh) ta hanyar Wat2Do kuma ya ce shi ne mafi kyawun lokacinsu. Wani mutum ya gano Retro Rollers (taron wasan kankara) kuma ya sami abokai shida sabo a cikin dare ɗaya.
about.phase3Paragraph4: Wannan shine lokacin da muka gane: wannan ba kawai kalanda ba ne. Hanya ce ta gano sigar rayuwar harabar da ba ku sani ba tana wanzuwa.
about.photo3Caption: Mutane sun fara gano taron da ba su taɓa sanin suna wanzuwa ba.
about.todayParagraph1: Wat2Do ana amfani da shi ta ɗalibai ɗaruruwa don gano taron da za su rasa in ba haka ba. Daga panels sadarwa na Bloomberg zuwa tafiye-tafiye na Jirgin Ruwa zuwa gasashen Wasan Bidiyo.
about.todayParagraph2: Ba mu gudanar da tallace-tallace ba. Ba mu sayar da bayananku ba. Mu kawai muna tunanin rayuwar harabar ya kamata ta zama mai sauƙi don kewaya.
about.todayParagraph3: Idan kun sami wannan yana da amfani, faɗa wa aboki.
about.guideTitle: Yadda Ake Amfani Da Wannan A Zahiri
about.guideDescription: Ga abin da muka koya game da yin amfani da mafi yawan taron harabar.
about.guideIndustryWie: WiE × Panel Bloomberg: Injiniyoyi na gaske waɗanda suke amsa tambayoyi da gaskiya. Bugu da ƙari, yawanci suna kawo abinci mai sauƙi.
about.guideIndustryAtlassian: Tattaunawar Kofi na Atlassian: Hanyar ƙasa da tsoro fiye da rumfar baje kolin aiki. Kuna iya yin tattaunawa a zahiri.
about.guideIndustryStartup: Baje Kolin Aiki na Startup: Tsallake manyan rumfunan kamfani. Tafi kai tsaye zuwa startups inda za ku iya magana da masu kafa na gaske.
about.guideRandomTitle: Abubuwa na Bazuwar Da Ya Kamata A Bincike
about.guideRandomRepair: Ƙungiyar Gyara: Kuna da charger na kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka? Waɗannan mutane suna da kayan aiki kuma za su koya muku yadda za ku gyara shi da kanku. Gabaɗaya kyauta.
about.guideRandomGatka: Ƙungiyar Gatka: Fasahar yaƙi na Sikh da sanduna na itace. Ba a buƙatar gogewa. Ba a ƙidaya ba.
about.guideRandomRetro: Retro Rollers: Wasan kankara a wuraren wasan gida. Mai kyau don rage damuwa yayin tsakiyar lokaci.
about.guideFriendsFood: Taron Abinci Kyauta: Tsara ta "An Bayar da Abinci" a cikin tacewa. Shawara ta ƙwararru: ku bayyana mintuna 15 da farko.
about.guideFriendsGames: Dare na Wasanni: Cikakkiyar ƙaramar hira. Yawancin ƙungiyoyi suna ba da wasanni.
about.guideFriendsWonderland: Tafiye-tafiye na Wonderland na Kanada: Ƙungiyoyi daban-daban suna shirya tafiye-tafiye na rukuni masu ragi. Hanyar arha fiye da tafiya kaɗai.
about.footerPS: P.S. Ba mu gudanar da tallace-tallace ba. Komai yana gudana daga aljihunmu. Babu sayar da bayanai. Kawai ɗalibai suna taimaka wa ɗalibai.
